review: chord-review-r1 (A QUALIFIED_PASS, B PASS, C QUALIFIED_PASS, D PASS bounded, E QUALIFIED_PASS; PROCEED with conditions)

rulings.scope: The printed 'for any n != 4' is false at n = 1, 2 by the source's own table (no credit for that). Credit only for the full proof of the intended statement n >= 3, n != 4 (matching the source's Lemma 5.2(2) 'for any n > 2'), following precedent 372205. The Lean endpoint must also state the n = 1, 2 facts and the n = 4 count (exactly four diagrams).
rulings.fidelity: ACCEPTED: genus may be defined through a combinatorial boundary count, under the reviewer's four conditions: (1) define b(F) as the textbook rotation-system face count (three half-edges per endpoint) and prove the lane's two-dart model equal to it; (2) keep the two empty-circle terms; (3) define genus by 2g = n + 2 - b, or prove the parity lemma, without relying on integer division; (4) add decide sanity lemmas reproducing source table entries. Equivalence of words up to rotation, reversal and renaming must be literal.
rulings.significance: QUALIFIED_PASS, modest: a genuine full proof of an explicitly open published conjecture (JKTR 2015); the source's lemmas give only existence; the new 5-chord lemma and the shortest-odd-cycle reduction are the content.
